messages.content:
Beth watches the happy couple slowly shuffle around the floor to the love ballad the band plays. She looks at her baby sister's face, aglow with love for the man who swept her off her feet. Beth knows she should feel proud but today just highlights what a mess her life is. She finishes her glass of champagne, her third — just one more drink she's had.

She looks around the room, checking out the men. Not much... But one guy catches her eye as he walks towards her. He's tall, he's handsome, he's...

"Jack? Is that you?"
